title: Clawd X Digest
summary: Frontier Model Security & API Vulnerabilities: Security researchers discover a method to extract hidden reasoning logs from frontier AI models across major provider APIs.
Open-Source LLM Releases & Agent Frameworks: NVIDIA introduces Nemotron 3.5 Lightning (30B MoE), Qwen prepares a 27B release, and Composio benchmarks DeepSeek V4 Flash across agent harnesses.
OpenAI Executive & Safety Departures: Key leaders across ethics, safety systems, and mission alignment resign from OpenAI amidst ongoing strategic shifts.

Fintech Innovations & Financial Infrastructure: X Money officially launches the 𝕏 Card debit & credit product featuring cashback and zero global ATM fees, while NYC recovers $9M in Amazon delivery fines.
AI Curation & Datacenter Architecture: New platforms automate 500+ daily Arxiv preprint evaluations, while designers unveil residential-datacenter hybrid heating concepts.

items.title: @kotekjedi_ml: Hidden Reasoning Extraction Vulnerability in Frontier AI APIs
items.body: Security researchers demonstrate a technique for extracting hidden reasoning logs and internal thinking chains from frontier AI models due to API endpoint vulnerabilities.

items.title: @NVIDIAAI: NVIDIA Debuts Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B MoE Model
items.body: NVIDIA introduces Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, an open 30B Mixture-of-Experts model with 3B active parameters engineered for high-throughput, always-on AI agents.

items.body: Reports highlight the departure of OpenAI's head of ethics, head of safety systems, and head of mission alignment within recent weeks.

items.title: @composio: DeepSeek V4 Flash Benchmarked Across 4 Agent Harnesses
items.body: Composio evaluates DeepSeek V4 Flash across Hermes, Pi, Prime, and Deep Agents frameworks on 30 complex agentic tasks, highlighting Pi Agent's strong performance.
